title: Brainwaves V1.1
description: The frequency, in Hz, of each EEG band of a person or of a group of persons.

MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) associated with this Brainwaves instance.

UEnvironment.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) associated with this Brainwaves instance.

BrainwavesTime.description: Time of the measurement or estimate the frequencies refer to.

EEGObjectID.description: Identifier of the EEG Object from which the frequencies were derived, if any.

BrainwavesData.description: The frequency, in Hz, of each EEG band.

Delta.description: Frequency of the delta band, in Hz (0.5 to 4 Hz).

Theta.description: Frequency of the theta band, in Hz (4 to 8 Hz).

Alpha.description: Frequency of the alpha band, in Hz (8 to 13 Hz).

Beta.description: Frequency of the beta band, in Hz (13 to 30 Hz).

Gamma.description: Frequency of the gamma band, in Hz (30 to 100 Hz).
